description: National Hydrography Dataset is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS, United States Geological Survey. The National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) represents the water drainage network of the United States with features such as rivers, streams, canals, lakes, ponds, coastline, dams, and streamgages. As of October 1, 2023, the NHD was retired. NHD data will continue to be available, but no longer maintained. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Economy, Energy and Utilities, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
